scenes.say: Same mug. The second it's yours, you want double for it.
The endowment effect: we value things more just because we own them.
Kahneman, Knetsch and Thaler handed mugs to half a class.
That's why we keep old junk, bad investments, and can't sell a house at market price.
Ask: if I didn't own this, would I buy it today at this price?
